description: Northern Provincial Council - Northern Province Finance (Amendment) Statute No. 04/2017
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a provincial finance amendment statute (Finance (Amendment) Statute of the Northern Province Provincial Council No. 04 of 2017). It involves legal amendments to existing legislation (Finance Statute of Northern Province, No. 01 of 2014) and falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory matters, specifically dealing with statutory instruments and legal modifications at the provincial level.
